name: Guwahati
metaTitle: Clinic & Hospital Management Software in Guwahati | Lucoze
metaDescription: Cloud HMS and EMR for Guwahati clinics and hospitals: GS Road, Bhangagarh, Six Mile and Zoo Road. ABHA number on record, DPDP 2023 ready, data in Indian data centres.
lead: Clinic and hospital software for Guwahati's practices — one cloud platform for records, billing, lab and pharmacy. Free 14-day trial, and you can be live in about 14 days.
intro: Guwahati is the Northeast's medical hub — patients travel in from Assam, Manipur, Mizoram and beyond for care they can't get at home, which means your front desk handles heavy, mixed-language footfall every day. Lucoze puts records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy on one cloud platform, so a specialist on GS Road or a hospital in Bhangagarh isn't stitching together separate registers. It runs on ordinary broadband or mobile data and records the ABHA number at the first visit. Our team works from Konnagar, West Bengal, supporting you remotely-first, with on-site help for larger hospital setups.
points: As the region's referral hub, Guwahati clinics see patients from every corner of the Northeast — search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the right record fast.
One system for the hospital belt
From Bhangagarh's hospitals to Zoo Road and Six Mile clinics, keep records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy in one place instead of five.
ABHA number and scheme claims at registration
Record ABHA numbers under Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and state schemes at the first visit, ready for the referrals arriving from across the region.
Every record stays in Indian data centres under DPDP 2023, with CSV and PDF export any time you want out.
Patients who journey in from across the Northeast get WhatsApp reminders, set up for your clinic during onboarding, so a follow-up or pending report isn't lost to the trip home.
localContext: Guwahati's clinics cluster along GS Road, Zoo Road, Six Mile and the Bhangagarh hospital belt, with Paltan Bazaar busy in the centre. Because patients arrive from across the Northeast, your desk juggles Assamese, Bengali, Hindi and English in a single queue. Lucoze runs in English, in short plain labels, and onboarding trains your front desk on your own patients, so a mixed queue doesn't slow the counter. Support is remote-first from our team in Konnagar, Hooghly, with on-site help for larger hospital rollouts. Because many arrivals come off long journeys from Manipur, Nagaland or the Barak Valley and won't return casually for a forgotten report, WhatsApp reminders, set up during onboarding, cut the no-shows that referral footfall creates. The same record carries from the doctor's chamber to the in-house pharmacy, so a travelling patient collects medicines against the visit without re-registering, and mixed cash-and-UPI payments settle on one bill.

faqs.q: Does Lucoze need a fast internet connection?
faqs.a: Lucoze is cloud-based and kept lightweight, so it runs on ordinary broadband or mobile data. A working connection is needed, and we stay reachable on WhatsApp if a busy OPD on GS Road hits a slow patch.

faqs.q: Where is our patient data stored?
faqs.a: In Indian data centres under the DPDP Act 2023. Your data never leaves the country, and you can export everything to CSV or PDF whenever you like — no lock-in.

faqs.q: Can Lucoze handle patients who speak different languages?
faqs.a: Patients can speak any language at your counter; the screens your staff use are in English, with short plain labels. Onboarding trains your front desk on your own patients, and search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the record.

faqs.q: Can Lucoze remind patients who've travelled from other Northeast states?
faqs.a: Yes. WhatsApp reminders are set up for your clinic during onboarding, which helps when a patient has come in from Manipur, Nagaland or the Barak Valley and won't drop by casually for a pending report. Prescriptions carry from the chamber to the in-house pharmacy on the same record, so nothing is re-entered.
